outline.title: Eight-month home routine of Nicoletta Palmi

habits.label: Wake up
habits.note: Earlier on school days, later on free days.

habits.label: Take birth-control pill
habits.note: Regular medication habit; no additional health condition inferred.

habits.label: Prepare a light dinner
habits.note: She enjoys cooking, but some evenings use leftovers or social plans.

habits.label: Watch a film or television
habits.note: Often a film during free evenings.

habits.label: Weekly meal preparation
habits.note: Batch cooking varies with weekend plans.

habits.label: Evening walk
habits.note: Weather and gym attendance affect occurrence.

authoringAssumptions: Nicoletta lives alone because no co-residents were specified.
The horizon starts on 2026-08-03 in Europe/Rome.
Her school commitment is represented as a weekday absence from 08:00 to 14:00 during the school term.
Gym attendance is represented as recurring absence on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
Birth-control medication is modelled as a regular morning medication habit without inferring a medical condition.
Boat use is represented by bounded warm-weekend outdoor events because detailed away-from-home activities are outside the home-centred catalog.
The villa includes the mandatory catalog rooms plus a study and garage; external locations include the school, gym, supermarket, marina and coastal waters.

fixedCommitments.label: Teaching and school duties
fixedCommitments.note: Recurring absence at Idioms High School.

phases.label: Late-summer boating season
phases.note: Warm weekends are more often spent at the marina or on the boat.

phases.label: Autumn school term
phases.note: School-day anchors become earlier and more regular.

phases.label: Winter reduction in outdoor walks
phases.note: Short daylight and winter weather reduce outdoor walking.

phases.label: Winter and early-spring school term
phases.note: Routine resumes after the winter break.

events.label: Boat outing from Rimini marina
events.note: Outdoor absence representing use of her boat; detailed boating actions are intentionally not modelled.

events.label: Winter holiday family visit
events.note: A bounded away-from-home family visit during the winter break.

events.label: Pre-season boat maintenance at marina
events.note: Outdoor absence for preparing the boat before the warm season.
